Concept art is the foundation of a game’s visual identity. It establishes the look, feel, and tone of a project, serving as a key reference for everyone involved in development. The Concept Artist’s role is to translate ideas into compelling visuals that drive the artistic vision forward. At EA SPORTS FC, Concept Artists play an important role in shaping the game's visual target. Their work serves as the visual building blocks for environments, characters, lighting, and props. Collaborating closely with the Art Team, they help visually interpret creative briefs, explore original ideas, and create artwork that determines the final style and mood of the project. Responsibilities Communicate with Development Directors on tasks, scheduling and assignments; collaborate with Art Directors to hit visual targets; and support the Character Art team during production cycles. Working with the Concept Art Lead, gather reference and create Mood Boards for various garments, shoes, and accessories across multiple styles & fashion genres. Prepare and present multiple design roughs for directional approval, implement feedback and create detailed final garment and outfit concept art in a timely manner. Support 3D artists by delivering clear, well-structured visual guides that translate seamlessly into in-game assets. Stay up to date with industry trends and techniques, bringing fresh ideas and innovations to the team. Required Qualifications A passion for fashion is a must as the main focus for this position will be to concept a multitude of player clothing items for an in-game vanity system. Experience designing and concepting game characters in all phases, including rough sketches, refined lineart and full color renderings. Familiar with creating Directional Packages including turnarounds, detail shots of accessories, and material call-outs. Ability to reinterpret and render realistic real-world fashion garments including structural details like hems, seams, pockets, patterns, fit, and folds in a clear and accurate manner. Knowledge of realistic anatomy and the fundamentals of the human body, including core muscle groups and how they connect to the skeleton, proportion, weight and mass, figure posing and costuming. Knowledge of clothing, fabric, materials and how they drape and fold around bodies. Ability to render various materials accurately, including lighting, weight and surfacing. Skilled in rendering and dynamically posing figures in motion, action and dramatic situations. Versatile and able to design and concept realistic-looking and stylized characters and costumes, both from imagination and from reference. Experience creating multiple pattern variations using color, texture and graphics. Solid awareness of posing figures, posture, facial expression, gesture and movement. Good graphic design & typography skills and the ability to create logos, tattoos, faux brand names and other stylized art treatments often found on clothing. Nice to Have Basic knowledge of 3D workflows and the ability to integrate 3D greyblocks or models into concept development. Collaborative by nature and can work with Cine, VFX and other visual directors to determine a specific vision. Storyboard experience, including working knowledge of cinematography terms, shots and common techniques and terminology used when creating storyboards. The ability to read and interpret scripts, discuss cinematic team requirements and be a strong visual partner in storyboard creation. Skilled in creating concept key frames for animation, VFX, and motion graphics. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
AI has the power to dramatically accelerate the pace of scientific discovery and the development of healthcare interventions. We're hiring Anthropic’s first dedicated Life Sciences Counsel to work side-by-side with our researchers as they work to advance biomedical progress.
You’ll serve as their trusted counsel on a wide range of efforts - from fast paced life sciences transactions with top research organizations to navigating the complexities of operating at frontier pace in a regulated ecosystem. This role carries unusual scope for a single lawyer: you will be the embedded legal partner to the team, while collaborating deeply across the broader legal department to pull in the wide range of subject matter expertise this strategic initiative will require for success.
Key responsibilities
Serve as a key strategic advisor to our life science research teams on complex research, development, and commercial matters globally
Drive high deal volume with life science and biopharma counterparties across a range of sophisticated agreement types
Identify, analyze, and proactively manage life science regulatory risks in close coordination with the broader Legal department
Design and implement scalable guidance and processes to support our fast-growing life science efforts
Anticipate emerging legal developments affecting AI technologies in the life science and biopharma space and provide strategic guidance to leadership
Minimum qualifications
Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based
Real fluency in how the life sciences industry works: how drugs get developed, how research organizations are structured, what pharmaceutical and biotech counterparties care about, and why
Working knowledge of the regulatory environment life sciences tools may be deployed in — GxP, clinical and health data regulations, human-subjects research, FDA processes
Deep experience with negotiating and drafting complex IP allocation issues in multi-party research arrangements, including ownership of inventions and improvements
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate legal risk into practical guidance for scientists, researchers, and business partners
Experience scoping and managing outside counsel across specialties (FDA/regulatory, IP, privacy, export control) for both substantive depth and cost efficiency
Exceptionally collaborative disposition - with the ability to find creative solutions that account for multiple priorities at once
A low-ego, high-empathy orientation and a "doer" attitude — willing to roll up your sleeves and pitch in where needed
Intense curiosity about AI and science, and a commitment to responsible AI development
Preferred qualifications
10+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial experience in life sciences transactional work — contract research, strategic collaborations, and licensing and commercialization deals — with the ability to operate independently and hit the ground running
Experience with AI/ML companies or products deployed into regulated scientific and clinical settings, particularly for drug discovery
Familiarity with biosecurity, dual-use research, or export control considerations in the life sciences
Experience leveraging AI to optimize their work, with a desire to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment
Scientific or technical training

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time.
